name: World Region: Samurai Village
purpose: World Map Region 1 Banner — Samurai Village.
description: Rustic wooden huts, bamboo groves, and dirt training courtyards under a gentle crimson morning sun.
prompt: A masterwork minimalist 2D flat vector panoramic game environment banner. Pure solid pitch-black silhouettes of rustic feudal Japanese village huts, bamboo training dojo courtyard, and Mount Fuji in distance. Centered glowing flat crimson sun in twilight sky. Pure solid pitch-black silhouette foreground (#000000), deep crimson accents (#FF2035). Clean razor-sharp vector shapes, high contrast, no 3D rendering, no soft painting, no realism, no human face, no text, no watermark.
